decisions.reason: The hierarchical search bundle carries little visible commitment and has not appeared on the website since 2018, so it may be quietly retired, but as a cheap add-on to the core web map platform it is likely still kept.

VueTOC was an experimental mobile component announced in 2018 with no visible follow-up since, so its early public announcement no longer justifies keeping it and its function is likely absorbed into other offerings.
The GIS platform is the firm's flagship product line and central to its announced direction, so heavy investment and public commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.
The search extension has its own page and is tied to the firm's web map app ecosystem, so management will keep it as part of the committed platform despite limited recent visibility.
